json.take: You can ask Bastian Sandoval to recycle possession all day, but without any simulation replays or pitch control numbers in the data, that theoretical pass is pure guesswork. In real time, taking the guaranteed shot on the table beats banking on an unmeasured alternative that assumes defenders will just let you set up camp outside their box.
